description: Retrieve the current gas price for Ethereum or Base for transaction planning. Returns wei and gwei from a single `eth_gasPrice` JSON-RPC call; live network result may change between calls and does not estimate total transaction cost, submit a transaction, or provide execution authorization. USE WHEN: an agent needs the current EVM gas price before estimating fees or preparing a transaction. DO NOT USE WHEN: the agent needs to inspect an existing transaction by hash (use `evm_transaction_hash_lookup`) or retrieve a wallet balance (use `evm_wallet_balance_lookup`).
